verdict.rationale: The evidence shows generic passkey/WebAuthn, PIV, and OATH support, plus custom attestation keys. Nothing names or documents integration with Okta, Entra ID, or Google Workspace, or any way to enforce hardware-key policies. Generic FIDO2 protocol support and attestation customization are building blocks; enforcing policy is an identity-provider feature, not something the evidence shows the key delivering.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key integrates with my identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace — and I can enforce policies requiring hardware-key authentication
